gates.name: Repo structure
gates.description: Validates repository structure and layout conform to Vibe Coding OS conventions

gates.name: References
gates.description: Validates references/index.json and ensures upstream references are properly tracked and attributed

gates.name: Registry schemas
gates.description: Validates registry and schema files are well-formed JSON and conform to their declared schemas

gates.name: Pack schemas
gates.description: Validates pack schema definitions are structurally sound and internally consistent

gates.name: Traceability
gates.description: Validates internal cross-references: broken links to commands, skills, or templates; detects orphaned inventory items

gates.name: Injection scan
gates.description: Scans for prompt injection, role hijacking, and unsafe instruction patterns across templates and skills

gates.name: Secret scan
gates.description: Scans repository for leaked secrets, credentials, private keys, and sensitive data

gates.name: Memory redaction
gates.description: Verifies memory entries have been properly redacted of sensitive data before storage or export

gates.name: Adapter smoke tests
gates.description: Runs smoke tests against runtime adapters to verify basic connectivity and contract compliance

gates.name: CLI smoke tests
gates.description: Runs smoke tests against CLI commands to verify basic invocation and response behavior

gates.name: E2E workflow
gates.description: End-to-end workflow test validating the full lifecycle from task initiation through completion

gates.name: Dashboard data
gates.description: Validates dashboard data generation and ensures all required data fields are present

gates.name: Dashboard sync check
gates.description: Verifies DASHBOARD.md is in sync with actual repository state and generated data

gates.name: Release metadata
gates.description: Validates release metadata files are consistent, well-formed, and match expected versioning

gates.name: Evaluation report
gates.description: Generates and validates the quality evaluation report covering all repo health metrics

gates.name: Bilingual README sync
gates.description: Ensures README.md and README.vi.md have consistent structure and parallel content sections

gates.name: Markdown links
gates.description: Validates all internal and external markdown links resolve to existing files or reachable URLs

gates.name: README heading version
gates.description: Verifies README heading version string matches the declared project version

gates.name: ROADMAP-STATUS integrity
gates.description: Validates ROADMAP-STATUS.md integrity, milestone status consistency, and cross-reference accuracy

gates.name: Runtime behavioral tests
gates.description: Runs behavioral tests against runtime components to verify correct execution patterns and error handling

gates.name: Quality diff audit
gates.description: Audits quality-metric changes in the diff to detect regressions or improvements in code and documentation quality

gates.name: Quality scorecard report
gates.description: Generates the quality scorecard report aggregating results from all gate executions
